001package com.streamConverter.path;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004import java.util.Optional;
005import java.util.stream.Stream;
006
007/**
008 * Type-safe representation of CSV column selectors.
009 *
010 * <p>This class encapsulates CSV column selectors used for navigating CSV documents. It supports
011 * both column name-based and index-based selection and validates the selector syntax at
012 * construction time.
013 *
014 * <p>Supported selector types: - Column name: "userName", "first_name" - Column index: "0", "1",
015 * "2" (zero-based) - Case-insensitive column name matching
016 *
017 * <p>This implementation provides type safety for CSV column operations in StreamConverter.
018 */
019public class CSVPath extends AbstractPath<Integer> {
020
021  private static final String TYPE = "CSVPath";
022  private final String selector;
023  private final boolean isIndex;
024  private final int columnIndex;
025
026  /**
027   * Creates a new CSVPath instance.
028   *
029   * @param selector the column selector (column name or index as string)
030   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the selector is null, empty, or invalid
031   */
032  public CSVPath(String selector) {
033    super(selector, TYPE);
034    this.selector = this.path;
035
036    // Determine if this is an index or name-based selector
037    int parsedIndex = parseAsIndex(this.selector);
038    if (parsedIndex >= 0) {
039      this.isIndex = true;
040      this.columnIndex = parsedIndex;
041    } else {
042      this.isIndex = false;
043      this.columnIndex = -1;
044    }
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Factory method for creating a CSVPath from a column index.
049   *
050   * @param columnIndex the zero-based column index
051   * @return a CSVPath for the column index
052   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnIndex is negative
053   */
054  public static CSVPath fromIndex(int columnIndex) {
055    if (columnIndex < 0) {
056      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column index cannot be negative: " + columnIndex);
057    }
058    return new CSVPath(String.valueOf(columnIndex));
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Factory method for creating a CSVPath from a column name.
063   *
064   * @param columnName the column name
065   * @return a CSVPath for the column name
066   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnName is invalid
067   */
068  public static CSVPath fromName(String columnName) {
069    if (columnName == null || columnName.trim().isEmpty()) {
070      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column name cannot be null or empty");
071    }
072
073    String trimmed = columnName.trim();
074    // Ensure it's not a valid index to avoid ambiguity
075    if (parseAsIndex(trimmed) >= 0) {
076      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
077          "Column name cannot be a valid integer index: " + columnName);
078    }
079
080    return new CSVPath(trimmed);
081  }
082
083  @Override
084  protected String validateAndNormalize(String rawSelector) {
085    if (rawSelector == null) {
086      throw new IllegalArgumentException("CSV column selector cannot be null");
087    }
088    if (rawSelector.trim().isEmpty()) {
089      throw new IllegalArgumentException("CSV column selector cannot be empty");
090    }
091
092    return rawSelector.trim();
093  }
094
095  @Override
096  public void validate() {
097    // AbstractPathから呼ばれる場合、selectorはまだ設定されていないので、pathを使用
098    String selectorToValidate = selector != null ? selector : path;
099
100    if (selectorToValidate == null) {
101      throw new IllegalArgumentException("CSV column selector cannot be null");
102    }
103
104    // isIndexフィールドが初期化されていない場合、parseAsIndexで判定
105    boolean isIndexValue = isIndex;
106    if (selector == null) { // まだコンストラクタ中の場合
107      int parsedIndex = parseAsIndex(selectorToValidate);
108      isIndexValue = parsedIndex >= 0;
109    }
110
111    if (isIndexValue) {
112      // Index validation already done
113      return;
114    }
115
116    // Validate column name
117    if (!isValidColumnName(selectorToValidate)) {
118      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid CSV column name: " + selectorToValidate);
119    }
120  }
121
122  // === CSVPath特化メソッド ===
123
124  public int getColumnIndex() {
125    return columnIndex;
126  }
127
128  public String getColumnName() {
129    return isIndex ? null : selector;
130  }
131
132  // === AbstractPath実装 ===
133
134  @Override
135  protected boolean doMatches(Integer currentColumnIndex) {
136    // CSV処理でのカラムインデックスマッチング
137    if (isIndex) {
138      return columnIndex == currentColumnIndex;
139    }
140    // 名前ベースの場合は実際のCSVヘッダー情報が必要
141    // ここでは簡易実装
142    return false;
143  }
144
145  @Override
146  protected <R> Optional<R> doExtract(Object data, Class<R> resultType) {
147    validateResultType(resultType);
148
149    try {
150      // CSV行データからカラム値を抽出
151      if (data instanceof String[]) {
152        String[] csvRow = (String[]) data;
153        if (isIndex && columnIndex >= 0 && columnIndex < csvRow.length) {
154          if (resultType == String.class) {
155            return Optional.of(resultType.cast(csvRow[columnIndex]));
156          }
157        } else if (!isIndex) {
158          // 名前ベースアクセスの場合、ヘッダー情報が必要
159          // 実装は簡易版のためスキップ
160          return Optional.empty();
161        }
162      } else if (data instanceof java.util.List) {
163        // リスト形式のCSVデータ処理
164        java.util.List<String> csvRow = (java.util.List<String>) data;
165        if (isIndex && columnIndex >= 0 && columnIndex < csvRow.size()) {
166          if (resultType == String.class) {
167            return Optional.of(resultType.cast(csvRow.get(columnIndex)));
168          }
169        }
170      }
171      return Optional.empty();
172    } catch (Exception e) {
173      return Optional.empty();
174    }
175  }
176
177  @Override
178  protected <R> Stream<R> doExtractAll(Object data, Class<R> resultType) {
179    validateResultType(resultType);
180
181    // CSV全行からのカラム値抽出
182    // 実装は簡易版
183    return Stream.empty();
184  }
185
186  /**
187   * Checks if this is an index-based selector.
188   *
189   * @return true if this selector represents a column index
190   */
191  public boolean isIndexBased() {
192    return isIndex;
193  }
194
195  /**
196   * Checks if this is a name-based selector.
197   *
198   * @return true if this selector represents a column name
199   */
200  public boolean isNameBased() {
201    return !isIndex;
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * Resolves this selector to a column index using the provided headers.
206   *
207   * @param headers the CSV headers
208   * @return the resolved column index, or -1 if not found
209   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if headers is null
210   */
211  public int resolveIndex(String[] headers) {
212    if (headers == null) {
213      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Headers cannot be null");
214    }
215
216    if (isIndex) {
217      // Validate that the index is within bounds
218      return columnIndex < headers.length ? columnIndex : -1;
219    }
220
221    // Search for column name (case-insensitive)
222    for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
223      if (headers[i].trim().equalsIgnoreCase(selector)) {
224        return i;
225      }
226    }
227
228    return -1; // Not found
229  }
230
231  private static int parseAsIndex(String value) {
232    try {
233      int index = Integer.parseInt(value);
234      return index >= 0 ? index : -1;
235    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
236      return -1;
237    }
238  }
239
240  private static boolean isValidColumnName(String columnName) {
241    if (columnName == null || columnName.isEmpty()) {
242      return false;
243    }
244
245    // Basic validation: non-empty, printable characters, common CSV column name patterns
246    // Allow letters, digits, underscores, spaces, hyphens, and dots
247    return columnName.matches("^[a-zA-Z0-9_ .-]+$") && !columnName.trim().isEmpty();
248  }
249
250  @Override
251  public String toString() {
252    if (isIndex) {
253      return String.format("CSVPath(index=%d)", columnIndex);
254    } else {
255      return String.format("CSVPath(name='%s')", selector);
256    }
257  }
258
259  @Override
260  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
261    if (this == obj) return true;
262    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
263    CSVPath csvPath = (CSVPath) obj;
264    return Objects.equals(selector, csvPath.selector);
265  }
266
267  @Override
268  public int hashCode() {
269    return Objects.hash(selector);
270  }
271}
